# FanFolder

> FanFolder is a free Windows 10/11 taskbar utility. Click its icon and recent documents, or the files of any folder you choose, fan out from the taskbar. It is the Windows equivalent of macOS Stacks. Native C++, per-user install, no administrator rights, free for personal and commercial use.

Facts: current version 1.4.3. Requires Windows 10 version 2004 or later, or Windows 11, on x64 or ARM64. Install with `winget install OleBhartvigsen.FanFolder`, from the Microsoft Store, or from the direct installer.

## Main pages
- [Homepage, features, download and FAQ](https://olebhartvigsen.github.io/FanFolder/): what FanFolder does and how to install it
- [Privacy and telemetry](https://github.com/olebhartvigsen/FanFolder/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): one anonymous install event, opt-out via registry
- [License](https://github.com/olebhartvigsen/FanFolder/blob/main/LICENSE.md): free for life, source not published
